usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and pushover alerts your phone when “New Task Created in Project” runs “Send a Pushover Notification”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Send a Pushover Notification” in pushover
bestTemplate.why: A task added to a project reaches your devices as a push notification, so nothing waits unseen.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, so the notification follows a scheduled check.
